page_title: MNT 3-2 AUX | Montpellier v Auxerre 22/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90+4' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Auxerre.
90+4' Paul Joly (Auxerre) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Auxerre force a corner. They send men into the box.
90+2' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Donovan Leon comes off his line to intercept.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
88' The referee allows time for a substitution. Teji Savanier will be replaced by Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier).

86' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Dimitry Bertaud leaps like a salmon to deny him.
85' Montpellier keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
84' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
82' Christophe Pelissier prepares a substitution. Kevin Danois is replaced by Paul Joly (Auxerre).
82' The substitution is prepared. Theo Bair (Auxerre) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ki-Jana Hoever.
80' One of the Auxerre players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
78' The current number of corner kicks is 11:4.
76' Booking. Akor Adams (Montpellier) receives a caution from the referee.
76' 3 - 2 Goal! Teji Savanier slips a clever pass through to Akor Adams (Montpellier), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the bottom right corner. 3:2.
73' 2 - 2 Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre) jumps for a cross and plants a precise header low inside the left post.

71' 2 - 1 A perfect lofted pass from Falaye Sacko finds Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header straight into the bottom left corner. His effort was both strong and precise, and Donovan Leon had no chance of stopping that. 2:2.
71' Substitution. Khalil Fayad will be replaced by Birama Toure (Montpellier).
70' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) replacing Becir Omeragic.
67' Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
66' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
65' 1 - 1 Akor Adams (Montpellier) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:1.
65' Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
65' The ball goes behind for a corner. Montpellier will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
64' A substitution has been made. Hamed Junior Traore is replaced by Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre).
64' Here is a change. Florian Aye is going off and Christophe Pelissier gives the last tactical orders to Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre).
63' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
61' Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.
61' Auxerre concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Montpellier are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
60' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
57' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
57' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
55' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
55' A lofted cross from Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Good work from Montpellier as they win a corner.
54' None of the Auxerre players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

53' Florian Aye (Auxerre) connects with an accurate pass inside the box and fires the ball to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players steps in to block the effort. Auxerre will take a corner kick.
51' The ball goes out for a corner. Montpellier can continue in their attacking effort.
51' The resulting set piece from Montpellier is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
51' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
50' The ball is cleared after Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
48' Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
48' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Auxerre comes to nothing.
47' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Auxerre.
46' Half-time substitution. Michel Der Zakarian decided to make a change. Lucas Mincarelli (Montpellier) is replaced by Enzo Tchato.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The end of the first half.
45+6' It will be a corner kick for Montpellier.
45+5' Lucas Mincarelli (Montpellier) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort. Montpellier have been awarded a corner kick.
45+4' Lucas Mincarelli (Montpellier) sends a long ball in, but Donovan Leon comfortably gathers the ball.
45+3' Akor Adams (Montpellier) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
45+2' Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Here comes a substitution. Jubal is given a rest as he is replaced by Rayan Raveloson (Auxerre).
44' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) is found in space by a decent pass, and he immediately hits a rocket of a shot at goal that clips the top of the crossbar.
43' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) sends a long ball in, but Donovan Leon comfortably gathers the ball.
41' Montpellier get a corner.

40' Akor Adams (Montpellier) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the right side of the goal, but Donovan Leon made a superb athletic save to deny him. The referee signals a corner kick to Montpellier.
39' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Falaye Sacko (Montpellier).

37' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Dimitry Bertaud. This effort really didn't trouble him.
36' The ball goes out of play. Montpellier are awarded a corner kick.
35' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

35' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Montpellier are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
33' Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
31' The ball is out of play and Auxerre manage to earn a corner.
31' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. Auxerre have a corner.
30' Auxerre will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
28' The game is interrupted now, Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
27' Yanis Issoufou is substituted due to injury. Michel Der Zakarian gives a chance to Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier).
26' Yanis Issoufou (Montpellier) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
24' Montpellier force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
24' Yanis Issoufou (Montpellier) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Montpellier.
23' Montpellier take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
21' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
20' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Montpellier was in an offside position.
18' 0 - 1 Goal! Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
17' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) was too forceful with his tackle and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
16' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) will take a corner kick.
15' Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Corner kick. Montpellier will have an opportunity.
13' Montpellier are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
12' Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
11' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
10' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) is penalised for holding. Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem signals a set piece. Auxerre will take a free kick near the side line.
9' Lucas Mincarelli (Montpellier) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
8' Rough tackle by Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
7' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre).

5' Akor Adams (Montpellier) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.

4' Auxerre slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
3' One of the players from Montpellier times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
2' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Montpellier will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem.
